papers.title: An Effective Strengthening Strategy of Nano Carbide Precipitation and Cellular Microstructure Refinement in a Superalloy Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting Process
papers.abstract: An effective strategy to strengthen a superalloy processed by selective laser melting (SLM) is proposed. The aim is to increase the yield strength of Inconel 718 fabricated by SLM to beyond 1400 MPa, which has never been achieved before. In this study, various NbC additions (0.0%, 0.5%, 1.0%, and 5.0% by weight) were added in the powder bed of Inconel 718, and two types of post-SLM heat treatments were investigated, i.e., solution heat treated plus aging (STA) and direct aging (DA). With NbC addition, smaller depth of melt pool and finer dendritic cells were obtained. Both STA and DA promoted the precipitations of γ′ and γ″. STA eliminated the cellular dendrites and induced grain growth while DA retained the as-built cellular dendrites, grain size, and nano-carbide from NbC addition, rendering a significant 326.2 MPa increase in yield strength. In this work, 0.5% NbC addition exhibited a record-high yield strength of 1461 MPa and ultimate tensile strength of 1575 MPa for Inconel 718 processed by laser manufacturing process according to literature data to-date.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高SLM制备Inconel 718的屈服强度至1400 MPa以上。
summary_zh.method: 添加不同含量NbC并进行两种热处理（STA和DA）。
summary_zh.result: 0.5% NbC+DA得到1461 MPa屈服强度，创纪录。
summary_zh.validation: 拉伸力学测试验证强度提升。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the yield strength of selective laser melted Inconel 718 beyond 1400 MPa, a level not previously achieved.
summary_en.method: Different weight fractions of NbC (0-5%) were added to the powder bed, followed by solution treatment plus aging or direct aging.
summary_en.result: The combination of 0.5% NbC and direct aging yielded a record-high yield strength of 1461 MPa and ultimate tensile strength of 1575 MPa.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile) was performed to validate the strength improvement.

papers.title: Critical Role of Etching Parameters in the Evolution of Nano Micro SLA Surface on the Ti6Al4V Alloy Dental Implants.
papers.abstract: The surface of dental implants plays a vital role in early and more predictable osseointegration. SLA (sandblasted large grit and acid-etched) represents the most widely accepted, long-term clinically proven surface. Primarily, dental implants are manufactured by either commercially pure titanium (CP-Ti) or Ti6Al4V ELI alloy. The acid etch behavior of CP-Ti is well known and its effects on the surface microstructure and physicochemical properties have been studied by various researchers in the past. However, there is a lack of studies showing the effect of acid etching parameters on the Ti6Al4V alloy surface. The requirement of the narrow diameter implants necessitates implant manufacturing from alloys due to their high mechanical properties. Hence, it is necessary to have an insight on the behavior of acid etching of the alloy surface as it might be different due to changed compositions and microstructure, which can further influence the osseointegration process. The present research was carried out to study the effect of acid etching parameters on Ti6Al4V ELI alloy surface properties and the optimization of process parameters to produce micro- and nanotopography on the dental implant surface. This study shows that the Ti6Al4V ELI alloy depicts an entirely different surface topography compared to CP-Ti. Moreover, the surface topography of the Ti6Al4V ELI alloy was also different when etching was done at room temperature compared to high temperature, which in turn affected the behavior of the cell on these surfaces. Both microns and nano-level topography were achieved through the optimized parameters of acid etching on Ti6Al4V ELI alloy dental implant surface along with improved roughness, hydrophilicity, and enhanced cytocompatibility.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及牙种植体的酸蚀表面处理，未涉及增材制造或力学性能测试。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing, no LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Ti6Al4V合金牙种植体酸蚀参数对表面形貌的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变酸蚀温度和时间，优化表面处理参数。
summary_zh.result: 实现了微纳双尺度表面形貌，提高了粗糙度和亲水性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞实验验证了表面处理后的细胞相容性。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to understand the effect of acid etching parameters on Ti6Al4V ELI alloy dental implant surfaces, which differ from commercially pure titanium.
summary_en.method: Optimization of acid etching conditions (temperature, time) to achieve micro- and nano-scale topography on Ti6Al4V ELI alloy dental implants.
summary_en.result: Optimized etching parameters produced dual-scale roughness with enhanced hydrophilicity and cytocompatibility.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture assays were used to evaluate the biological response to the treated surfaces.
